title: EventsReadRequest
description: events.read-request@1: request bodies of the pull API on OpenVibe.Events (events.event.read, events.app.read). PUT /api/v1/checkpoints: { topic, cursor } stores the calling consumer's cursor for a topic pattern (an app's patterns must start with a literal segment and app.* must name its own project_key). GET /api/v1/events?topic=&after_seq=&limit=, GET /api/v1/events/:event_id, GET /api/v1/checkpoints?topic= and GET /realtime/stream?topics= take no body.

topic.description: Dot-separated segments of [a-z0-9_] or *, where * stands for one or more whole segments (*.* is refused).

cursor.description: A seq (next_after_seq of the last page handled).
